IN THIS ISSUE: LADY BIRD, AFTER YANG AND MINARIOPEN THE ISSUE ↓
IN THIS ISSUE
NOVEMBER 2026

Living with family.
There is plenty to argue about.

Lady Bird wants to leave home. The family in After Yang is learning to say goodbye; the family in Minari is trying to make a farm work. This issue looks at the arguments and daily routines that make these three films so recognisable.

LADY BIRD / AFTER YANG / MINARI
CLOSE READING / LADY BIRD3 MIN READ

Greta Gerwig’s mother and daughter can agree on a dress more easily than on a future. Their arguments make Lady Bird feel painfully familiar.
